long_biography.plain_text:
Prince Jefri Bolkiah has represented Brunei in polo as both a player and a team manager. At the Southeast Asian Games in Kuala Lumpur in 2017, he managed a national side that included Prince Abdul Mateen and Princess Azemah Ni’matul Bolkiah.

He subsequently joined the squad that won the low-goal tournament at the 2019 Games in the Philippines, contributing during its first three matches. Brunei defeated Malaysia in the final to secure the country’s second gold medal of those Games. The result marked the first time a Bruneian contingent had won more than one gold at an overseas edition of the competition.
